**Yes—0072 correctly excludes global channel 17 from MIDI-recorder cleanup; allocating bank 17 would conceal the invalid call. I found no confirmed implementation blocker in 0071/0072, but case 015 has an incorrect timing assertion, and pending-edit isolation needs a stronger test.**

- **0072 preserves the intended scope.** [recorder.lua:8](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/recorder.lua:8) allocates only channels 1–16. The guard at [m_clock.lua:361](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/clock/m_clock.lua:361) matches the existing global/MIDI dispatch separation. [The integration test:1618](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/tests/lib/m_clock_tests.lua:1618) checks that global wraps preserve banks 1 and 16, then selected-channel wrap clears only bank 1. The supplied baseline/candidate receipts confirm 489 successes plus one error versus all 490 passing.

- **0071 preserves future-step writes and the explicit Off rule.** [step.lua:123](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/step.lua:123) sends the retained dirty value through `p.action(dirty)` without changing the default; cancellation occurs only inside `dirty ~= off`. [m_clock.lua:374](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/clock/m_clock.lua:374) dispatches this before notes, while recording writes remain afterward. Distinct-default replay assertions at [trig_parameter_interactions.py:365](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/trig_parameter_interactions.py:365) independently test stored values; they are not circular.

- **Fix test 015, not slide output.** The matrix now reports **failed**, not running. Its [failure receipt](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-runs/fa93545db32f46bfbd5ff56c89d9563e/manifest.json:28) identifies [recording_lifetimes.py:82](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/recording_lifetimes.py:82). Captured CC96 occurs at logical `28354444445`, before note 3 at `28410000001`: approximately **55.556 ms early**, consistent with rounding the eight-second, 72-unit ramp. Existing interpolation quantizes values, and [step.lua:218](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/step.lua:218) suppresses equal repeats. Keep the exact ramp sequence assertion; replace endpoint-message/onset equality with an independently calculated quantized timeline. Off must not force an extra destination write.

- **Add one focused pending-isolation scenario:** leave assignment/configuration edits unconfirmed across an eligible step, then cancel; verify original-route dirty output and distinct-default replay. [Current tests:40](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/recording_lifetimes.py:40) confirm immediately, leaving that interval untested. Source places invalidation at application, but native evidence should exercise the boundary.

**CONFIDENCE: Medium overall; High on 0072 and the 015 assertion defect.** Remaining native cases and broader ten-slot/mute/song/undo/persistence/reset domains remain unverified; no tests, edits, launches or delegation were performed.
